clips.text: A new project on Mathburst, ledger at zero. The learner asks for the whole pipeline. The agent reads the page first, through the site tools.
The learner writes the Gamma recurrence by hand. There's a sign error in it... left in on purpose.
The agent reads the ink, circles where integration by parts flips the sign, and leaves a note. It marks. It doesn't fix.
The learner corrects the tail and accepts live math. The LaTeX is typed into a fresh equation, then scaled with real handles.
It pans down and builds the Gamma density from nothing. Axes, then the curve, then the area, split into three masses.
Drag the shape and the bound; the masses follow. Then the bridge: masses, log masses, softmax, each keeping its colour.
Attention. The agent raises one entry of W Q and explains as it goes. The weights move, and still sum to one.
One training step by the agent, undone. Eight by the learner. Every click is one honest gradient on the visible parameters.
Geometry. The learner places three points. Tangent circles, the homothety and the spiral centre draw in dependency order.
P is a weighted average of A, B and C. Weights that sum to one... like attention weights. So P glides to them.
Tidy-up. Shapes box the acts, arrows connect them, highlighter matches the weights. The agent erases its own circle, then undoes it.
Four weights instead of three. The tetrahedron draws in, the section recovers the triangle, and the lattice becomes the partition table.
The learner drags the cutoff. Ramanujan's congruence is verified for these finite cases. The general statement is a theorem, and the card says so.
A two by two matrix, typed by hand, sheared by tool. The lattice sweeps across. A matrix moves every vector at once.
One typo fixed, one LaTeX term retyped. Then a second project opens, untouched. Isolation, on camera.
Every tool, used at least once, through one shared history. [calm] Forty-eight tools. Both hands. One world.
